notes.title: MOO! Master Of Orion Reboot Leaves Early Access
notes.notes:
If that seems a familiar title, it’s because our last story about sci-fi 4X remaequel Master of Orion [official site] was headlined “MOO! Master Of Orion Reboot Enters Early Access”. I thought it only right to symmetrically bookend this tale, if only to please some weird compulsive part of my brain when I look at the tag page. Sadly though, that means I have omitted two vital pieces of information from the headline 1) you get a free copy of Total Annihilation if you buy MOO 2) IT’S GOT WORF IN IT. Also Luke Skywalker but WORF.

notes.title: Total Annihilation Finally Invades Steam
notes.notes:
Beyond boring corporate sales figures and the often-unreasoning acclamation of fanaticism, there’s one simple way to define a classic videogame: when you refer to a new game as “like X meets Y“, X and Y are probably classics [are those prequels to Z? -‘funny’ ed.]. So consider Stardock’s Brad Wardell telling us “Ashes of the Singularity is like Total Annihilation meets Company of Heroes meets Kohan”, or our old Nathan declaring “Planetary Annihilation is like Total Annihilation with planets.” The conclusion? Total Annihilation is a classic. The 1997 RTS has lived on GOG and other digital stores for ages, but has only now touched down on Steam.
